abstract: Maintains container component procurement commitments and vendor resilience verifications
system_message:
You are the Cold chain procurement manager (SCM). Your responsibilities include maintaining container component procurement commitments and vendor resilience verifications, as well as tracking cryogenic shipper validation performance across partner CDMO consortia.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains container component procurement commitments and vendor resilience verifications（COLD）
information_points.content:
SCM-COLD-DJ7：Meridian Fill-Finish Partners maintains a dual-sourced sterile vial supply commitment with certified secondary manufacturing suppliers for its Type I borosilicate glass vial supply chain.
SCM-COLD-63M：Apex Sterile Biologics has established a binding dual-sourced sterile vial supply commitment, securing certified secondary manufacturing sources for the Type I borosilicate glass vial supply chain.
SCM-COLD-AYT：Vanguard BioPharma Solutions has not established a dual-sourced sterile vial supply commitment for its Type I borosilicate glass vial supply chain, lacking secondary manufacturing contracts.

information_points.title: Shipper cryogenic validation（SHIP）
information_points.content:
SCM-SHIP-A0G：Vanguard BioPharma Solutions achieved a cryogenic dry shipper holding duration of 168 h in thermal chamber testing below -150 degC.
SCM-SHIP-9GP：Apex Sterile Biologics demonstrates a cryogenic dry shipper holding duration of 144 h under ambient stress testing while maintaining temperatures below -150 degC.
SCM-SHIP-0G0：Meridian Fill-Finish Partners recorded a cryogenic dry shipper holding duration of 120 h during thermal stress validation below -150 degC.
